body.name: Key inventory maintained
body.description: An inventory of shared and production access tokens is kept.
body.detail: Every credential in use is inventoried, but the API bearer token is the username itself — deliberately minimal, and not deployable as-is.
observations: app_user rows are the full inventory of API identities.
Service credentials: the Postgres DSN and Neo4j auth, both from environment.
GAP BY DESIGN: the token carries no secret. Production must terminate on the agency's SSO/PKI; tracex_api.auth.get_principal is shaped as the single seam that changes, so routers stay untouched.
